name: teamdynamix
description: Read Cedarville TeamDynamix tickets, activity, surveys and calendars using the local project connection.

interface.shortDescription: Find tickets and review service activity.
interface.longDescription: Read-only connection to Cedarville's InfoTech Tickets, with ticket search, details, activity, survey reports and a ticket-view app resource. Uses credentials from the dynamix-manager project.
defaultPrompt: Review a ticket and its recent activity.
